read.thesis: European restarts and three-year-high EBITDA of $98/t signal supply discipline and TRQ-driven pricing, with Q3 shipments guided stable to higher, a counterseasonal outcome, against $1.8bn strategic EBITDA targets.

utilisation.quote: we have brought back the furnaces, so we have three furnaces running. We will be running, actually, all of our furnaces in Europe from quarter three onwards.

capex.quote: We are creating space within our envelope to add some of these other projects.

triggers.label: Europe EBITDA/t $70 → $98
triggers.quote: Our European segment delivered an EBITDA per ton of $98, which is a three-years high

triggers.label: All EU blast furnaces restarted by August
triggers.quote: As we head into August, we have our full suite of blast furnaces in operation.

triggers.label: Q3 shipments stable to higher QoQ
triggers.quote: we are guiding to third quarter shipments to be stable to higher than the second quarter

triggers.label: China: at least 50% of industry loss-making
triggers.quote: at least 50% of the Chinese steel industry is currently losing money

guidance.quote: we are guiding to third quarter shipments to be stable to higher than the second quarter

guidance.value: 18 million tons full year, 10 million tons in H2
guidance.quote: In the second half, we need to ship about 10 million tons to get to this 18 million.
we have reiterated again the prospect of positive free cash flow this year.
We captured already $300 million in H1. We have another $400 million that we believe we should be capturing in H2

red_flags.label: Rising EU carbon costs with restarts
red_flags.quote: As we increase our production in Europe, you should anticipate that this will increase our carbon costs in Europe

red_flags.label: Liberia shipment delays from rainy season
red_flags.quote: because of the very heavy rainy season that we experienced, we had some delays in shipments

evasions.quote: Tristan, look, I think our guidance is quite clear.
No, I'm not going to comment on that, Bastian.

evasions.quote: None of that we can answer at this stage.
